# Build Documentation

## Overview

This directory contains the official Build Framework documentation for the
FamilyOS platform.

The Build Framework defines the principles, standards, processes, and
governance rules used to transform source code into reliable, reproducible,
and validated software artifacts.

---

## Purpose

The purpose of the Build Framework is to establish a consistent approach
for:

- software build processes;
- artifact generation;
- build automation;
- build validation;
- release preparation;
- reproducible delivery.

---

## Scope

The Build Framework applies to:

- Core Platform;
- Runtime;
- CLI;
- SDK;
- Domain Framework;
- Generation Framework;
- Official Plugins;
- Community Plugins;
- Documentation builds;
- Release artifacts.

---

## Build Principles

FamilyOS build management is based on:

- reproducibility;
- automation;
- consistency;
- traceability;
- validation.

---

## Relationship With Other Frameworks

The Build Framework integrates with:

| Framework | Relationship |
|---|---|
| Engineering Framework | Defines development practices |
| Testing Framework | Validates generated outputs |
| Quality Framework | Ensures build quality |
| Release Framework | Defines delivery process |
| Security Framework | Protects build integrity |

---

## Document Naming Convention

Build documents follow the naming convention:


BLD-XXXX-Document-Name.md


Where:

| Element | Description |
|---|---|
| BLD | Build document category |
| XXXX | Unique document identifier |
| Document Name | Human-readable document title |

---

## Build Framework Structure

The Build Framework is organized into:

| Area | Description |
|---|---|
| Foundation | Core build concepts and principles |
| Build Management | Configuration and automation |
| Build Operations | Environments and optimization |
| Governance | Validation and security |
